title: Design agent invariants project from one executable authority
statement: Generated design-agent manifests and design-governance audits project their invariant list from canon/invariants.jsonl; no second executable design-invariant list is permitted.

invariants.statement: Product source uses Inter and Satoshi only; serif media requires an exact approved exception.
Marketing pills are 32px visible inside a 44px minimum hit target.
The marketing O-mark is visibly 32px and control-aligned.
Accent color communicates semantic state or a named data category, never decoration.
Decorative icons and emoji have no border, ring, circle, or badge plate.
One canonical component family owns a concept; supported states are variants consumed as instances.
Founder review contains canonical masters and intentional variants, without receipts, duplicates, or filler.
Pen is proposal/review evidence until source identity and required persistence receipts pass.
Logos normalize visible non-transparent ink through the shared asset registry, never route-local crop or scale CSS.
Never crop album art. Use object-fit: contain, not cover. No gradient, overlay, play button, or chrome on album art, merch, or a face except optional mostly-transparent glass play/pause.

binds design projections to the canonical invariant registry

deliberateRed.name: rejects a duplicate design invariant projection
rejects a contradictory design invariant projection

title: One executable invariant registry
statement: canon/invariants.jsonl is the only executable invariant registry; GBrain records provenance and policy context only.

title: Invariant records are complete and stable
statement: Every invariant carries stable identity, scope, authority, effective version, precedence, consumers, evidence, and lifecycle.

title: Contradictions fail closed
statement: Overlapping contradictory policy fails validation until explicit auditable supersession names the winner and loser.

deliberateRed.name: rejects contradictory overlapping active invariants

title: Adoption requires enforcement and deliberate red
statement: An adopted invariant names a production consumer and a deliberate-red test that proves violations are rejected.

deliberateRed.name: rejects an adopted orphan without a bound consumer

statement: Summer changes authoritative Linear priority and intake state; eligible coding transitions produce durable intake acknowledgement and wake Symphony through the existing controller.

title: Fresh measured capacity governs new work
statement: New mutation requires fresh measured capacity plus lease and collision safety; stale or unknown capacity preserves queued work but grants no new lease.

title: Automatic release requires typed receipts
statement: Automatic landing or release requires predeclared policy, affected-product tests, required approvals, fresh authoritative gates, provenance, and a release receipt.

title: User-facing outputs require an optimization contract
statement: Every shipped user-facing page, link, asset, campaign, recommendation, or content variant has a complete optimization contract on existing analytics surfaces; non-product or non-optimizable work must declare a justified exception instead of omitting the contract.

title: Summer enforces No Unattended Red across PR stalls
statement: Every unhealthy or not-proven PR, CI, queue, deploy, provider, lease, or controller signal is classified immediately on the event and dispatched as evidence collection, a safe typed remediation, or an explicit authority blocker with one owner and lease, bounded attempts and backoff, a next-proof deadline, exact-head proof, and a terminal healthy or escalated outcome; periodic reconciliation recovers missed events only; not-proven is missing-evidence collection never a repair claim.

title: Changed screens require screen-certification/v1
statement: Changed user-visible screens on web, macOS Electron, and iOS fail CI unless they have typed ownership registration and exact-head proof at the required evidence tier; scheduled whole-system sweeps remain and cannot substitute for changed-surface proof. Decision/review proofs require one decision per viewport, no disclosure in the active flow, separate history/proof, and visible actions. Product-surface implementation owned by Ovie, auth/security, MenuMonitor, and iOS shell lanes is out of scope.
